_comment: The Nodes registry — single source of truth for the front door. Add a Node = add an entry here, push, and `git -C /var/www/nodes pull` on the box. slug → install URLs (/nodes/<slug>/{mac,windows}) and hosted app (/nodes/<slug>/app/). repo → github.com/pauldevelopai/<repo>. status: 'live' (shows install + online) or 'soon'. hosted: true if it runs online on the box. 'desc' may contain simple inline HTML (e.g. <em>). 'products': which storefront(s) show this Node — ['grounded'] = the newsroom front door, ['bair'] = the BE AI READY listing, ['grounded','bair'] = both (one Node, two storefronts; never copied). A MISSING products field is treated as ['grounded'] for backward-compat. The same Node is reused across products by ADDING a tag — never by duplicating the entry. 'kind':'builtin' marks a Node that lives INSIDE the tracker app (not a separate node-<slug> repo / not hosted on the box) — it has an in-app 'href' instead of a 'repo', renders as a storefront card like any other, but has no download/hosted-app links. LeadFinder is the first of these.

nodes.name: Audience Signal
nodes.desc: Reads a Word or PDF matrix of your published stories and their Facebook reach + engagement, and shows what your audience actually rewards — by beat, format, headline shape and over time. The signal is engagement rate, not raw reach, so boosting and the algorithm don't fool it.

nodes.name: Podcast Studio
nodes.desc: Train a journalist's voice from a short sample, then turn a transcript into an AI-generated audio podcast in that voice. Audio and keys stay on your own machine.

nodes.name: Election Watch
nodes.desc: AI-assisted claim verification and origin-tracking of suspicious content, tuned for the August 2026 Zambian elections. Verify claims against a corpus of past examples, and analyse where foreign-manufactured content came from.

nodes.name: Progress Tracker
nodes.desc: One accountability view of what every reporter is publishing across Facebook, the website, TikTok and WhatsApp. Give each reporter a personal submit link and they report their own day — AI turns it into entries — then see it by day, week, month or year, against each person's target, paired with how the posts actually performed.

nodes.name: AI Ready Archive
nodes.desc: Point it at your content — a folder from your computer, a Google Drive, a sitemap or pasted URLs — and it cleans and structures everything into AI-discoverable formats (clean markdown, schema, llms.txt), with page-by-page control over what AI crawlers, LLMs and agents may use and what stays private internal search.

nodes.name: SalesRep
nodes.desc: Capture a senior ad-sales editor's playbook through a short AI interview — buyer types, pricing, objections, scripts, seasonal plays — then coach a junior salesperson from it for prep, live calls and debriefs. A calibration loop sharpens the model every time you mark its advice right, wrong or needs-refining.

nodes.name: Extract PDF
nodes.desc: Drop in a PDF — an invoice, a bill of quantities, a statement — and get trusted structured data back as Excel, with every risky cell flagged to check and nothing ever guessed. BE AI READY.

nodes.name: Newsroom Voice
nodes.desc: Learns your newsroom's writing voice from your own past articles, then drafts new pieces in it. It only keeps the positions you've actually taken — each backed by a word-for-word quote from your text, nothing invented. BE AI READY.

nodes.name: LeadFinder
nodes.desc: Overnight tender watching. Pulls tenders from your sources, reads each one, and ranks them by how likely they are to convert — so your morning is a short list to act on, not a pile to sift.
